_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "active_generation" INTEGER NULL, "last_sync_at" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'never', "catalog_generation" INTEGER NULL, "last_attempt_at" TEXT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "server_time" TEXT NULL, "authorized_user_id" TEXT NULL, "authorization_expires_at" TEXT NULL, "receipt_pending" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("receipt_pending" IN (0, 1)), "required_app_version" TEXT NULL, "sync_lease_owner" TEXT NULL, "sync_lease_expires_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "installed_publication" ("site_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "publication_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "publication_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "manifest_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "manifest_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "signature_key_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "signature" TEXT NOT NULL, "etare_number" TEXT NULL, "site_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "published_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "installed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("site_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "publication_file" ("publication_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "media_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "required" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("required" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("publication_id", "path"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "file_blob" ("sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content" BLOB NOT NULL, "stored_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("sha256"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "site_data" ("site_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "publication_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "data_text" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("site_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "site_search" ("site_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "etare_number" TEXT NULL, "address_label" TEXT NULL, "city" TEXT NULL, "search_text" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("site_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "field_report" ("client_report_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "author_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "site_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "site_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "publication_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "publication_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "severity" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_type" TEXT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NULL, "item_label" TEXT NULL, "plan_revision_id" TEXT NULL, "plan_title" TEXT NULL, "plan_x" REAL NULL, "plan_y" REAL NULL, "photo_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "local_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "last_error" TEXT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" TEXT NULL, "server_report_id" TEXT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NULL, "received_at" TEXT NULL, "server_status" TEXT NULL, "decision_comment" TEXT NULL, "decided_at" TEXT NULL, "resolution_revision_no" INTEGER NULL, "resolution_publication_number" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("client_report_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "field_report_photo" ("client_report_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES field_report (client_report_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "filename" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" BLOB NOT NULL, "uploaded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("uploaded" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("client_report_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "on_demand_sites" ("site_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "publication_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "publication_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "manifest_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "site_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "etare_number" TEXT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "published_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "search_text" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("site_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sensitive_sites" ("site_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "publication_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "publication_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "site_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "opened_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "expires_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "wrapped_key" BLOB NOT NULL, "data_cipher" BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("site_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sensitive_files" ("site_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "media_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "cipher" BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("site_id", "sha256"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "access_event_outbox" ("client_event_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "site_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "publication_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("client_event_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "installed_basemaps" ("pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sector_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sector_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "manifest_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "manifest_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "total_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "built_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "renew_after" TEXT NOT NULL, "installed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "signature_key_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("pack_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trusted_keyset" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "keyset_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "root_key_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "signature" TEXT NOT NULL, "received_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1));
